sources.title: EAEU: Decision No.107 (20.12.2017) - unified customs payments for personal-use goods (incl. vehicles) (PDF copy)
TR CU 018/2011 (vehicle safety technical regulation) references

requirements: Vehicle must comply with EAEU technical regulation on vehicle safety (TR CU 018/2011) and related conformity procedures (EAC).
Pre-clearance verification is required before proposing final options.
fail_reasons: Compliance certification / conformity procedures are not confirmed.

params.soft_warn_over_years_note: Older vehicles usually trigger higher costs / more scrutiny.

warn_reasons: Vehicle age may significantly impact import costs and clearance complexity.
Fuel type may affect compliance, cost, and required documentation.

params.min_standard_note: Verify the required environmental class / emissions compliance during pre-clearance.

warn_reasons: Emissions/environmental class must be verified during pre-clearance.

params.rhd_note: RHD vehicles may face market/regional constraints and additional checks.

warn_reasons: Steering side may affect registration/market acceptance; confirm before shipment.

params.note: If vehicle is EV, confirm charging standard compatibility and destination infrastructure.

warn_reasons: EV charging/infrastructure compatibility should be confirmed for the destination.

notes: Always reconfirm import rules before shipment.
